title: Medicine show and circus bands in the old days
summary: Russell asks about the size of circus and medicine show bands; Braud says nine to twelve bands played in town for a week and drew farmers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Circus band, you know, and Gattles. So that old disco was proud. How big a band was that, about five or six? Oh, nine, 12 bands. Oh, many? Oh, 12 bands.

Oh, they used to do a hell of a business in the town for a week. Oh, I don't know. They did a hell of a business, yeah. All the farmers be coming to town, getting some snake oil and whatever they were selling. I don't know.

Dance bands, brass bands, show bands, you know, tent shows, art, and the medicine show and art. They got to have a little bit different tempos. Could you explain that? Well, they do have different tempos.
